# X Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that uses your X account: post and delete tweets, search recent tweets, like tweets, and send DMs via OAuth2. Writes need confirmation first. Honest note: X has no usable free read tier — the free tier is write-only (about 500 posts a month, about 100 reads a month); anything beyond basic writes needs a paid tier or pay-per-use pricing. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
